content:
**Mirelurk Queen Steak** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A piece of meat from a Mirelurk Queen which has been cooked to make it safer to eat.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Queen Mirelurk Meat | | Mirelurk Queen Steak (1) | 

Mirelurk Queen Steaks can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients. The recipe is automatically received when picking up Queen Mirelurk Meat for the first time.
